children.value: RLC low-pass: L = 10 mH, C = 100 nF
Each experiment explicitly alters R1 for its damping case.

files.text:
01 Underdamped | AC + Step
// 1. Change r in the alter command below; Canvas R1 remains the nominal value.
// 2. Click Run.
// 3. Plot Gain or the step; Measurements contains sampled peaks and final value.
ground 0
include "circuit.spice"
control
abort always
options rawfile="ascii" strictsave=2 temp=27 reltol=1e-8 vntol=1e-10 tran_fbr=0.025
alter instance("R1") r=200
save v(in) v(out) i(L1)
// AC is small-signal response, not an output-swing test.
analysis frequency ac from=100 to=1M mode="dec" points=100
analysis step tran stop=1m step=500n maxstep=500n
postprocess(PYTHON, "report.py", "rlc")
endc
